responsibility: Implements the Darwin-specific Rust frontend target hook object by overriding TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. Its job is to publish the Rust target metadata seen by cfg/target queries for Darwin-based builds, adding the target_family, target_os, target_vendor, and target_env strings via rust_add_target_info and then instantiating targetrustm with that hook bound. Unlike darwin.cc or darwin.h, it does not manage Mach-O code generation or driver specs; it is only the Rust-language OS-identification layer for Darwin.
